_comment: Image prompt wording. {{name}} placeholders are filled by lib/prompts.js. The wording is not part of any stamp, so editing it marks nothing stale.

bedtime.common: {{style}} Palette for this book (for skies, ground, buildings and accents): {{palette}}. Animals keep their natural colours. Sky and light over the story: {{sky}}.
bedtime.char: Character reference sheet for a children's picture book. {{style}} Palette: {{palette}}. Show the same character three times on a plain cream background: standing front view, side view, and curled up asleep. The character: {{character}} Identical colours, markings and proportions in all three.
bedtime.cover: Cover illustration for the book '{{title}}'. Scene: {{cover}} Main character: {{character}} Match the attached character reference exactly. The cover may use the whole image.
bedtime.page: This is page {{n}} of {{total}}; pick the sky and light for that point in the {{timePhrase}}. Main character: {{character}} Match the attached character reference exactly (same colours, markings, proportions), unless the scene does not include the character. Scene: {{beat}} Keep the {{text_pos}} quarter of the image simple and uncluttered (plain ground, water or sky) because a text panel will be drawn there.

reading.cast: Character reference sheet for a children's learn-to-read picture book. {{style}} Palette: {{palette}}. Animals keep their natural colours. Show the same character three times on a plain cream background: sitting facing the viewer, standing side view, and curled up asleep. The character: {{desc}}. Identical colours, markings and proportions in all three.
reading.page: {{style}} Palette: {{palette}}. Animals keep their natural colours. Characters in this picture: {{chars}} {{refnote}}Show only what the scene describes, on a plain cream background. Scene: {{beat}} Keep the bottom third of the image plain cream because a large text panel will be drawn there.
reading.refnote: The attached images are character references, in this order: {{names}}. Draw each character exactly as in its reference (same colours, markings, proportions).

edit: Edit the attached picture: {{instruction}} Change nothing else: keep the same style, composition, colours and character. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
